newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar's emir meets Britain's defence secretary.
newsitem.headline: Qatar's emir meets Britain's defence secretary.

text.p: Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani met British Defence Secretary Michael Portillo on Monday, Qatar's official News Agency said.
The agency said Portillo, who arrived in Doha earlier on Monday, discussed bilateral ties and issues of mutual interest with Qatar's emir and other senior officials. It gave no other details.
Portillo on Sunday held talks in another Gulf Arab state, Oman, where he met Sultan Qaboos.
